Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber from a source different from the EPG provider; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information, wherein the list is generated based on the retrieved channel subscription information.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers, wherein the extracted channel identifier is verified against the list prior to removal. 

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber from a source different from the EPG provider; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information, wherein the list is generated based on the retrieved channel subscription information.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers, wherein the extracted channel identifier is verified against the list prior to removal. 

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information, the display module being configured to present only the filtered EPG information based on the channel accessibility of the subscriber.
